Sam: Quick q — trying to reproduce weird kernel selection flips on mainline. Planning an nsys capture with short warmup + steady-state. Any non-obvious CLI flags or capture patterns?
Kai: First, separate warmup from steady-state. Either pre-warm KV cache with synthetic requests or use bracketed captures. Short runs often miss the kernel handoff.
Marta: Agreed. I usually do a 2-step approach: 20s preflight (warm), then 60-90s steady. Use --trace=cuda,nvtx,osrt to get kernel timelines + NVTX markers + OSRT sampling.
Priya: If you want low overhead sampling, try periodic sampling at ~1ms to 5ms instead of event tracing. Example command I run locally:
```
nsys profile --output=run.qdrep --trace=cuda,nvtx,osrt --sample=periodic:1000us --duration=90s
```
Sam: Nice. How do you exclude the warmup region without manual editing?
Kai: Use capture-range options or a small `sleep` before you kick the workload. Another trick: emit an NVTX marker after warmup (`nvtxRangePush("steady")`) and then filter the timeline in the UI to start at that marker.
Marta: Also watch out for short-duration bias: some kernels only appear once per full KV eviction cycle. If you're testing batching heuristics, run an extra long trace once (3-5m) to see eviction-induced kernel spikes.
Priya: For reproducing the kernel selection regression from yesterday's commit, i recommended enabling CPU thread sampling (osrt) — it helped me correlate scheduler stalls with kernel launches. `--trace=osrt` is cheap but very useful.
Sam: Any tips to keep file size reasonable? We hit huge .qdrep files before.
Kai: Limit `--duration`, prefer sampling over full API tracing, and avoid full-memory-copy tracing. You can also compress afterwards: `nsys convert --output run.sqlite run.qdrep` and keep the sqlite. Drop extraneous domains in the GUI export.
perf-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-perf/captures/4164321000-run.qdrep (45MB after trimming) :thumbsup:
Marta: TL;DR checklist I use: 1) pre-warm KV cache or bracket run 2) include NVTX markers for warm/steady 3) use periodic sampling (1ms-5ms) 4) long-run capture if eviction behavior suspected 5) filter timeline by marker in Nsight.
Sam: Perfect — I'm going to run `--sample=periodic:2000us` for 120s with NVTX markers and post the qdrep here. Thanks all :raised_hands:
